relations.evidence: 1949-1952, Roth resumed his studies at the Ludwig Maximilians Universität München ... On 31st July 1952, Roth passed the Phd. examinations in Indologie-Iranistik and Kunstgeschichte

relations.subject: Gustav Roth
relations.evidence: In August 1953, Roth followed an invitation of the Jaina Muni Ācārya-pravara Śrī Ātmārāma Jī Mahārāja, Ludhiyana, where he studied Ācārāṅga-Sūtram under Him.

relations.subject: Gustav Roth
relations.evidence: In May-June 1955, Roth visited Nepal. Under the guidance of Pt. Gunanath, he learned reading Nepalese Sanskrit manuscripts.

relations.subject: Gustav Roth
relations.evidence: Roth found the Sanskrit Text entitled Stūpa-lakṣaṇa-kāriakā-vivecanam ... which he deciphered with the help of Shri Hemraj Shakya. Government Epigraphist.

relations.subject: Gustav Roth
relations.evidence: Roth continued his research under the guidance of Prof. Gaurinath Shastri, Government Sanskrit College, Calcutta

relations.subject: Gustav Roth
relations.evidence: he joined the 'Seminar für Indologie' of Göttingen University as assistant of Prof. Ernst Waldschmidt.

relations.subject: Gustav Roth
relations.evidence: Febr. 1965 appointed 'Akademischer Oberrat' (Chief Academic Councillor) at Göttingen University with Prof. Heinz Bechert

relations.subject: Heinz Bechert
